note: Monroe County, AL has no queryable zoning-district service found. The county's public GIS (alabamagis.com/monroe, monroegis viewer) serves parcel and assessment lookups only. Monroeville, the largest city, publishes its zoning only as a 2018 PDF map. The parcel layer found in the county's ArcGIS web map (services1.arcgis.com/Ug5xGQbHsD8zuZzM, MonroeCountyParcels_Jan2026) is Monroe County, Georgia (Forsyth GA), not Alabama, so it is not usable.
